regime_context: The detector shows Gold Miners leading a broad but narrow-margin precious-metals block (Gold and Silver/Royalties both eligible, high breadth, high durability_bar), while Energy's Oil & Gas and Financials' Big Banks follow as secondary eligible momentum. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market (gate_helps true), so eligible themes are the legitimate focus; rotation radar shows no directional handoff and no one-narrative dominance. Cross-sectional rank is a focus lens only, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver & Royalties (rank 2, score 1.807) closes the 0.125 margin over Gold Miners and becomes the confirmed leader — only a durable score flip above Gold Miners WITH Silver & Royalties' own breadth rising above 0.7 would retire this watch; as long as Gold Miners holds rank 1, no handoff exists. The watch retires quietly if the margin widens beyond 0.3 in Gold Miners' favour.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners hold the top eligible rank with the highest durability_bar (0.7), full breadth (1.0), and non-crowded texture (crowding_z 0.53). This is the strongest trend-health combination in the current set — a durable, broad, still-uncrowded leadership — though it is a relative-strength statement, not a return forecast. The absolute-trend gate is validated here, so an eligible top-rank theme deserves the clearest directional lean.
evidence: gate_helps=true (validated drawdown control on this market)
theses.dissent: The r10 for the Gold Miners headline is negative (-0.0242), meaning a 10-day realized return is already negative despite the high momentum score — leadership may already be rolling over or the momentum signal is stale relative to price action.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the only non-precious-metal eligible theme with a positive score (1.24) and above-average crowding_z (0.8), suggesting it is the strongest distinct rotation candidate outside the precious-metals block. Durability_bar is 0.56 — adequate but clearly below the precious-metals leaders — and breadth is 0.5, so participation is only half the basket. This is a modest, secondary directional lean on trend continuation rather than a fresh leadership bet.
evidence: crowding_z 0.8 (highest eligible non-precious theme, but not crowded)
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.5 means half the index constituents are not confirming the trend — the score may be concentrated in a few large-cap names rather than a coherent energy theme; if energy-specific volatility spikes, the half-participation structure weakens quickly.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls 5% while the S&P/TSX benchmark is flat or up over the 20-day check-by window

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is ineligible (rank 10, score -0.458) with a mixed hurst tag and breadth 0.5 — it does not pass the absolute-trend gate and therefore sits outside the validated discipline on this market. The macro_narrative backdrop shows ai_tech as the most-mentioned dominant theme (n=6), which is coincident market-level context, but the detector's own trend-health reading on the Canadian Tech theme is clearly negative. The gate is the one validated edge here, and Tech fails it.
theses.dissent: Macro narrative is dominated by ai_tech headlines (n=6 in 5 days), and Canadian Tech could mean-revert higher if unscheduled flows rotate toward the AI theme before the next detector refresh — this avoidance is strictly trend-gate based, not a fundamental statement.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO changes from ineligible to eligible in the next detector state, or XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% before the 30-day check-by date
